_meta.purpose: Deterministic intake rules: what the 5 intake answers imply for eligibility, maximum cover and pricing inputs. Applied in code (knowledge.profile_snapshot); the LLM only reads the result.
_meta.status: Business assumptions set by the product owner, not insurer underwriting policy. The agent always says cover limits are indicative and final cover is decided by the insurer.

intake_questions.ask_en: And may I note your gender, for the premium estimate?
intake_questions.ask_hi: Premium estimate ke liye, aap male hain ya female?
intake_questions.infer_ok: May be taken from clear Hindi verb/pronoun forms ('bol rahi hoon'); confirm lightly if unsure.

intake_questions.ask_en: Are you salaried, self-employed, or not working at the moment?
intake_questions.ask_hi: Aap salaried hain, self-employed hain, ya abhi kaam nahi kar rahe?

intake_questions.ask_en: Roughly what is your yearly income? A range is fine.
intake_questions.ask_hi: Aapki saalana income lagbhag kitni hai? Range bhi chalega.
intake_questions.parse_note: Accept monthly figures ('80 hazaar mahina' -> 9,60,000/yr), lakh/crore words and ranges (use the midpoint). Skip if not_working.

intake_questions.ask_en: Have you used any tobacco or nicotine in the last 12 months, even occasionally?
intake_questions.ask_hi: Pichhle 12 mahine mein kabhi bhi tobacco, cigarette, gutka ya nicotine liya hai?
intake_questions.note: Insurers price and test for this (cotinine test), so honesty helps the customer.

max_cover.rule: income_multiple x annual_income_inr, for salaried and self_employed alike
max_cover.multiple_note: 25x up to age 35, 20x above 35 (per product owner). CONFIRM the >35 band; no further step-down is applied at older ages.
max_cover.self_employed_note: Same multiples, but the insurer will ask for income proof (typically ITRs); mention it when relevant.
max_cover.not_working: No term cover on their own life from these 10 products (none of the brochures offers cover to non-earners). See not_working_options.
max_cover.product_caps: Final max for a product = min(income-based max, product max sum assured if any). If the product's min sum assured > income-based max, the product is not feasible for this customer.
max_cover.rounding: Round down to the nearest Rs 5 lakh below Rs 1 crore, nearest Rs 25 lakh above.

not_working_options.option: Spouse cover under the earning partner's term plan
Savings plans (premium affordability decided with the advisor)

icici-assured-savings.reason: Minimum annual premium is Rs 20 lakh; ASSUMPTION: only pitch when that is <= 20% of income. Never say the figure as a price unless asked.

pricing_inputs.salaried_discount: Apply the product's stated first-year salaried discount (pricing.json) and say it applies to the first year only.
pricing_inputs.default_quote_points: Quote each eligible term plan at Rs 1 crore (if <= max cover) and at the customer's max cover, regular pay, policy term to age 60 or the anchor's term, whichever the product allows.
